facts.text: Our counter, 138th Street / Cut through Central Park / 72nd Street and Broadway / Down to Wall Street
facts.why: The 72nd Street pay phone comes before the Central Park drive. McClane's own line in the film is '72nd and Broadway to Central Park South in three minutes', and he says the park is the best way south to Wall Street. The card has the park before 72nd.
facts.fix: Our counter, 138th Street / 72nd Street and Broadway / Cut through Central Park / Down to Wall Street

facts.why: In the transcript Simon sends McClane to the corner of 138th Street and Amsterdam, in Harlem.

facts.text: Gyro platter -- eaten in a stolen taxi
facts.why: McClane and Zeus ride in a cab, but no source shows them eating a gyro in it.
facts.fix: Gyro platter -- eaten on the run

facts.text: Bacon egg and cheese on a roll -- McClane hasn't slept in days
facts.why: The film runs over a single day, so days without sleep is not backed.
facts.fix: Bacon egg and cheese on a roll -- McClane hasn't stopped all day

vibe.verdict: The Harlem placemat is a clever frame and the jug answer is right. The route order is off and the food leans on guesses.
missing: Simon says on the pay phone (72nd Street)
Aspirin from the truck stop (the ending)
ideas: Fix the taxi race order so 72nd Street comes before the park
Add 'Simon says' to the placemat footer, replacing the plain print line
Swap 'Cold Soda' joke for the aspirin from the truck stop
Rename the 'Gyro platter' as a 'Taxi snack' and keep it brief
